Loop Tuner

An oscilloscope for control loops. The display shows the signals of the loop; you set the loop up in the tabs below, one step at a time. Right now the Input tab is built: a signal generator for the reference r(t).

Display

RRun / Stop. Running sweeps the record in real time, over and over. SSingle: one sweep, then stop AAuto Scale: fit the timebase and every channel to the data KnobsDrag, scroll, or focus and use the arrow keys. Double-click a Position knob to zero it. Channel keysSelect a channel for the Vertical knobs; press again to turn it off

Signal generator

Press a waveform key to draft a component: the display shows it dashed on its own and added to r(t). Adjust it, then Add. Click a component in the stack to edit it.

0–9 . -Type a value for the active field; Enter sets it EnterWith nothing typed: add (or apply) the draft EscClear what you typed, or cancel the draft ← →Move the digit cursor ↑ ↓Change the digit under the cursor (the dial does the same) TabNext field Ctrl ZUndo; Ctrl Shift Z redo

Files

The project is one JSON document, including how the display is set. Save it, open it, drop it on the page or paste it. Export HTML writes this page with the project inside, to send to someone.
